name: CRAG_FREEBASE_RESOLUTION_OVERLAY_V1

RELATION_TO_FROZEN_GRAPH.rule: the overlay is a SIDECAR keyed by node_uid. CRAG_FREEBASE_CANONICAL is not modified, not rewritten and not re-hashed. Its manifest hash 6672dab172cf5dde79c56685153d4e257be3527b5ee93b07514ad2f40425c5fb remains valid.
RELATION_TO_FROZEN_GRAPH.join_key: node_uid (int64), unique in the frozen node table by the node_uid_unique check
RELATION_TO_FROZEN_GRAPH.why_a_sidecar: resolution is a progressive, source-dependent process that will be revised as sources are added. Baking it into a frozen table would make every revision a re-freeze and would destroy the one property that makes the frozen artifact citable.

COLUMNS.display_text: string, NEVER null in the finished overlay and NEVER a bare MID
COLUMNS.resolution_confidence: float, defined by RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE below -- a documented scale, not a free-floating score
COLUMNS.source_reference: string or null. For an authoritative tier, the exact evidence: the metadata table and field, the deleted-triples file and line, the archival URL and capture date. For a structural tier, the rule id that generated the text.

RESOLUTION_SOURCE.LITERAL_SELF: the node IS a literal; its lexical form is its text. Authoritative by construction.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.FREEBASE_CURRENT_EXACT: type.object.name in the frozen metadata. The strongest tier.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.FREEBASE_KEY_EXACT: no name, but a /type/object/key in the frozen metadata yields a human-readable path. Authoritative, from the source of record.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.FREEBASE_DELETED_EXACT: recovered from deleted_freebase.tar.gz, Google's one-time dump of triples deleted through March 2013. Authoritative but HISTORICAL: the fact was true of Freebase at some point and was later deleted, which is not the same as being true of the final snapshot.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.WIKIDATA_MAPPING_EXACT: fb2w.nt.gz gives an owl:sameAs Wikidata Q-id. NOTE this yields an identifier, not text, so it is never sufficient on its own.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.WIKIDATA_LABEL_EXACT: a Wikidata label resolved through the mapping above. MEASURED CEILING: only 20,024 unnamed nodes appear in fb2w at all, so this tier cannot exceed 0.1033% of the unnamed population regardless of how much Wikidata is acquired.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.ARCHIVE_EXACT: recovered from an archived Freebase page or other historical capture. Requires a per-hit archival URL and capture date in source_reference; never accepted in bulk without one.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.URI_DERIVED: the node is an EXTERNAL_URI and its text is derived deterministically from the URI itself. Not a recovery: the URI was always readable.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.STRUCTURAL_INFERRED: no historical text survives, but the node's type and incident schema determine a description. Deterministic and reproducible; NOT a claim about what the node was called.
RESOLUTION_SOURCE.STRUCTURAL_FALLBACK: as above with the type itself unrecovered, so the description is built from role signatures only. The weakest tier and the one that guarantees the opaque count reaches zero.

RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE.1.0: LITERAL_SELF, FREEBASE_CURRENT_EXACT, FREEBASE_KEY_EXACT, URI_DERIVED -- present in the frozen source of record or derivable from the identifier itself.
RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE.0.9: FREEBASE_DELETED_EXACT, WIKIDATA_LABEL_EXACT, ARCHIVE_EXACT -- exact string evidence, but from outside the final snapshot, so temporally weaker.
RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE.0.5: STRUCTURAL_INFERRED -- the type is authoritative, the phrasing is generated.
RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE.0.0: STRUCTURAL_FALLBACK -- carries NO identity claim. A zero here means the text exists for retrieval and embedding only.
RESOLUTION_CONFIDENCE.rule: confidence is a property of the SOURCE CLASS, not a per-node judgement. It is assigned by tier and never tuned per node.

TARGETS.honesty_rule: reaching zero opaque nodes is an OPERATIONAL claim about CRAG never seeing a bare MID. It is not a claim that every node's original name was recovered. The two must be reported side by side, and a summary that gives the first without the second is a misreport.

EXTERNAL_URI.note: 0% carry display_text today, but the URI is self-describing; this is a display rule, not a recovery problem.

CVT_MEDIATOR.note: anonymous by design. Freebase never named mediators; 99.42% having no name is the expected state, not a defect.

COST_FLAG_MEDIATOR_ROLES: MEDIATOR[type.path] needs only a metadata join and is cheap. The role-filled form (actor -> ..., film -> ...) needs each mediator's incident edges, which is a pass over all 2,062,430,072 canonical edges. Both are deterministic; only the second is expensive. Decide the form before building, not during.
SUPERSEDES_NOTHING: this contract adds an artifact. It does not amend V3_CANONICAL_CONTRACT_V4 or any frozen record; per standing discipline a change to those requires a new record with its own hash, never an edit.
